note: The seouterwall kit's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md). The host's ground layers (47-host-land.js): ground.puna (the col's dry bunchgrass, the base, tinted by season), ground.cobble (ground.wadi.cobble: the meltwater gully's floor and its fan, the outwash flat), ground.gravel (ground.gravel019: the moraines' till and the scree), ground.tundra (the moraines' turf, the dwarf shrubs in the lee), ground.lichen (ground.lichen.crust: the crags' fellfield and the high slopes), ground.needles (the larch's litter in the sheltered shaded hollows), rock.megabreccia (the crags and the walls, read from the side on the steep: KGROUND's triplanar sides; tinted by KSTRATA's megabreccia and tibasalt columns; the rockfall heaps' blocks), rock.basalt (rock.basalt.titanium: the same on the Godthrone's side of the corridor, station 2's headwall: SITE.rock.lib). The flora's cards and barks are the NW outer wall's pack, read in place. Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/seouterwall after any change, then python3 build.py.
